name: TelegArm
author: hamed7ir
description: TelegArm is a Telegram client for Windows written entirely in managed C#. It speaks MTProto directly through the WTelegramClient library with no native Telegram component, and one AnyCPU + Prefer32Bit build runs on ARM32 Windows RT 8.0 and 8.1 and Windows 10 ARM32, on x86 and x64 Windows 7 SP1 through 11, and on ARM64 Windows 10 and 11. It requires .NET Framework 4.7 or later: Windows RT 8.1 ships only 4.5, so the runtime must be installed first — on ARM32 from the Open-RT redistributables mirror, because Microsoft's web installer serves no ARM32 build — and RT 8.0 needs the .NET Framework 4.8 update, which is currently difficult to obtain there.
dependencies: Windows RT 8.0 only: the .NET Framework 4.8 update must be installed before the app will start. It is currently difficult to obtain for RT 8.0.
instructionSteps: On Windows RT 8.1, jailbreak the device first — RT only runs unsigned desktop apps after the jailbreak.
On Windows RT 8.1, install .NET Framework 4.7 from https://files.open-rt.party/Software/Redistributables/ — Microsoft's own web installer serves no ARM32 build.
On Windows 10 ARM32 .NET 4.7 is already present; no action is needed.
On Windows RT 8.0, install the .NET Framework 4.8 update first — the app will not start without it, and it is currently difficult to obtain for that version.
Copy TelegArm-1.9.0-Setup-AnyCPU.zip to the device and extract it.
Keep Setup.exe and payload.zip together in the same folder — Setup reads the payload from beside itself.
Run Setup.exe, and press Check requirements first if you are unsure whether .NET 4.7 is present.
Let it install per user into %LocalAppData%\Programs\TelegArm; no administrator rights are needed.
On Windows 7, also install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015 or later redistributable (x86) — TelegArm runs without it, but animated stickers stay still.
